org.sizing: Balanced: one mobile-first page around a small pure calculation core, so one frontend engineer designs, builds and tests it, and I check the result against your words at the end.

plan.goal: A portfolio/client-grade, mobile-first tip calculator web page (Vite + TypeScript): bill, preset + custom tip %, split between people, round up; currency and number formats follow the browser's locale (Intl) with a currency picker; the last tip % and currency are remembered (localStorage); every state is designed.

milestones.title: Calculation, locale and memory core tested
Designed page working on phone and desktop

tasks.title: Scaffold the project and build the tested tip maths
Locale parsing, currency picker data and remembered settings
Design and build the calculator page

errors: “Design and build the calculator page” (p-3) is too big for one context: its files span 6 areas (the project root, src, src/ui, src/styles, public, docs). Split it by area into tasks that each own one area with its own tests and check (never one task to build and another to test), keeping each to 4 areas, 2400 characters of brief and 6 requirements.
